description:
A Kodama spirit that follows you and warns you of nearby enemies.

**Kodama Companion**

*! Summon Song Update !*

Plant trees so Kodama will help you! The trees are our friends <3
Once you have earned a Kodama, you can also summon it by playing C - E - G on the recorder. This requires the Recorder mod
(https://content.luanti.org/packages/_Krush/recorder/) and is optional.

Features:

- Smooth orbiting movement — gentle, natural hovering
- Look-at reaction — Kodama notices when you gaze at it, drifts closer, and responds with a sound
- Hostile mob detection — Kodama glows and alerts you to danger
- Happiness mechanic — needs petting every 60 seconds (visual + sound only — no speed penalty)
- Recorder integration — play C - E - G on the recorder to summon your Kodama
- 6 Color Variants — Blue, Green, Gold, Purple, Red, and Default
- Custom sounds — summon song, look-at reaction, sleep sound, and more
- Glows in the dark
- Custom particle effects (happy, sad, alert, magic, summon, sleep)
- Persistent storage — your bond AND color choice survive server restarts
- Leaves with a sad little tap if neglected for 150 seconds


| Command | Description |

/kodama_call | Summon your Kodama companion (if you have earned one) |

/kodama_leave | Dismiss your Kodama|

/kodama_time | Check how long since you last pet your Kodama |

/kodama_status | Check Kodama and current color |


Color-Commands:

- /kodama_blue
- /kodama_green
- /kodama_gold
- /kodama_purple
- /kodama_red
- /kodama_default
